results.label: Theorem 1.1.
results.statement:
[S1.Thmtheorem1] Theorem 1.1.
 [S1.Thmtheorem1.p1] 
Let  $A,B$  be countable groups, let  $G=A*B$ , and let  $i_{A}:A\to G$  and  $i_{B}:B\to G$  be the inclusions. For every  $n\geq 4$ ,  $\alpha\in H_{n}(A;\mathbb{Z})$ , and  $\beta\in H_{n}(B;\mathbb{Z})$ ,
 [S1.Ex4] 
 $\operatorname{SphereVol}_{G}\bigl((i_{A})_{*}\alpha+(i_{B})_{*}\beta\bigr)=\operatorname{SphereVol}_{A}(\alpha)+\operatorname{SphereVol}_{B}(\beta).$

results.label: Corollary 1.2.
results.statement:
[S1.Thmtheorem2] Corollary 1.2.
 [S1.Thmtheorem2.p1] 
If  $M,N$  are closed connected oriented manifolds of the same dimension  $n\geq 4$ , then
 [S1.Ex5] 
 $\operatorname{SphereVol}(M\#N)=\operatorname{SphereVol}(M)+\operatorname{SphereVol}(N).$

results.label: Lemma 2.1 (Two norm foldings).
results.statement:
[S2.Thmtheorem1] Lemma 2.1 (Two norm foldings).
 [S2.Thmtheorem1.p1] 
Let  $H_{1},H_{2}$  be finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces. Define
 [S2.Ex7] 
 $\displaystyle L:S(H_{1}\oplus\mathbb{R}\oplus H_{2})$  $\displaystyle\longrightarrow S(H_{1}\oplus\mathbb{R}),\quad$  $\displaystyle L(x,z,y)$  $\displaystyle=\bigl(x,\sqrt{z^{2}+\|y\|^{2}}\bigr),$ 

 $\displaystyle R:S(H_{1}\oplus\mathbb{R}\oplus H_{2})$  $\displaystyle\longrightarrow S(H_{2}\oplus\mathbb{R}),\quad$  $\displaystyle R(x,z,y)$  $\displaystyle=\bigl(y,\sqrt{z^{2}+\|x\|^{2}}\bigr).$ 

If  $n\geq 4$ , then at almost every tangent  $n$ -plane  $E$  of a rectifiable  $n$ -current in the domain,
 [S2.E4] 
 $\operatorname{Jac}_{n}(L|E)+\operatorname{Jac}_{n}(R|E)\leq 1.$ (4)

results.label: Definition 2.2 (Vertex shadows).
results.statement:
[S2.Thmtheorem2] Definition 2.2 (Vertex shadows).
 [S2.Thmtheorem2.p1] 
Let  $T$  be a finite tree with at least one edge. Its edges index the coordinates of  $\ell^{2}(E(T);\mathbb{R})$ . For a vertex  $v$ , deleting  $v$  partitions the edge midpoints into branches, one for each incident edge  $e\in E_{v}(T)$ . Define
 [S2.E5] 
 $p_{v}:S(\ell^{2}(E(T);\mathbb{R}))\longrightarrow S(\ell^{2}(E_{v}(T);\mathbb{R})),\qquad p_{v}(u)(e)=\left(\sum_{a\text{ in branch }e}u(a)^{2}\right)^{1/2}.$ (5)

results.label: Lemma 2.3 (Tree Jacobian bound).
results.statement:
[S2.Thmtheorem3] Lemma 2.3 (Tree Jacobian bound).
 [S2.Thmtheorem3.p1] 
For  $n\geq 4$ , at almost every tangent  $n$ -plane  $E$  of a rectifiable current in  $S(\ell^{2}(E(T);\mathbb{R}))$ ,
 [S2.E6] 
 $\sum_{v\in V(T)}\operatorname{Jac}_{n}(p_{v}|E)\leq 1.$ (6)

results.label: Lemma 3.1 (Approximation and fillings).
results.statement:
[S3.Thmtheorem1] Lemma 3.1 (Approximation and fillings).
 [S3.Thmtheorem1.p1] 
Let  $G$  be countable and  $k\geq 1$ .
 [S3.I1] 
 [S3.I1.i1] (i)
 [S3.I1.i1.p1] 
For every  $C\in\mathbf{I}_{k}^{c}(X_{G})$  with  $\partial C=0$  and every  $\varepsilon>0$ , there exist  $P\in\mathcal{P}_{k}(X_{G})$  and  $D\in\mathbf{I}_{k+1}^{c}(X_{G})$  such that
 [S3.Ex15] 
 $\partial P=0,\qquad C-P=\partial D,\qquad\mathbf{M}(P)\leq\mathbf{M}(C)+\varepsilon.$ 

 [S3.I1.i2] (ii)
 [S3.I1.i2.p1] 
If  $Z\in\mathcal{P}_{k}(X_{G})$  bounds a current in  $\mathbf{I}_{k+1}^{c}(X_{G})$ , then  $Z=\partial Q$  for some  $Q\in\mathcal{P}_{k+1}(X_{G})$ , after common subdivision. No bound on  $\mathbf{M}(Q)$  is asserted.

results.label: Proposition 3.2.
results.statement:
[S3.Thmtheorem2] Proposition 3.2.
 [S3.Thmtheorem2.p1] 
The expressions (9) define homomorphisms
 [S3.Ex16] 
 $\mathcal{T}_{A}:\mathcal{P}_{k}(X_{G})\longrightarrow\mathbf{I}_{k}^{c}(X_{A}),\qquad\mathcal{T}_{B}:\mathcal{P}_{k}(X_{G})\longrightarrow\mathbf{I}_{k}^{c}(X_{B})\quad(k\geq 1),$ 

independently of lifts and polyhedral presentations. For  $k\geq 2$ ,
 [S3.E10] 
 $\partial\mathcal{T}_{A}(P)=\mathcal{T}_{A}(\partial P),\qquad\partial\mathcal{T}_{B}(P)=\mathcal{T}_{B}(\partial P).$ (10)

For  $k\geq 4$ ,
 [S3.E11] 
 $\mathbf{M}(\mathcal{T}_{A}P)+\mathbf{M}(\mathcal{T}_{B}P)\leq\mathbf{M}(P).$ (11)

results.label: Lemma 5.1.
results.statement:
[S5.Thmtheorem1] Lemma 5.1.
 [S5.Thmtheorem1.p1] 
Let  $K\subset X_{G}$  be compact, and let  $Z\subset K$  be the support of a liftable finite-support polyhedral current. For every  $\eta>0$ , there is a map  $F$  on a neighborhood of  $K$  such that
 [S5.I1] 
 [S5.I1.i1] (a)
 [S5.I1.i1.p1] 
 $F$  is locally  $(1+\eta)$ -Lipschitz;

 [S5.I1.i2] (b)
 [S5.I1.i2.p1] 
 $F(K)$  is contained in a carrier of the form (12);

 [S5.I1.i3] (c)
 [S5.I1.i3.p1] 
 $F|K$  is homotopic to the inclusion by a Lipschitz homotopy on  $[0,1]\times K$  with compact image, fixing  $Z$  pointwise.

The case  $Z=\varnothing$  imposes no relative condition.

results.label: Lemma 5.2.
results.statement:
[S5.Thmtheorem2] Lemma 5.2.
 [S5.Thmtheorem2.p1] 
Let  $Y$  be a finite spherical polyhedron with the piecewise spherical metric on each component, and let  $k\geq 1$ . Every integral  $k$ -cycle in  $Y$  is homologous in  $Y$  to a sequence of finite spherical polyhedral cycles whose masses converge to its mass. Moreover, a spherical polyhedral cycle which bounds an integral current in  $Y$  bounds a spherical polyhedral chain there, after subdivision.
